title: Supplements for LDL Cholesterol
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for supplements for ldl cholesterol.
evidence_strength: Established evidence on plant sterols, red yeast rice, and soluble fibers; moderate to emerging evidence for garlic, policosanol, and probiotics; safety data variable; clinical outcome data limited for most supplements.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
